svg.title: Pinstripe's tape measure: seven presets, each marked on the tape
svg.desc: A yellow tailor's tape measure unrolls from its case across a green card. Seven marks sit on it, one per Pinstripe preset: The cut, Pint: preset per, preset laravel, enforced; The inseam, PHPStan: level 8, ignores: noted, enforced; The lining, Larastan: larastan ^3.13, via installer, enforced; The press, Rector: deadCode, codeQuality, typeDeclarations, earlyReturn, enforced; The buttonholes, ESLint: javascript, typescript, vue + a11y, enforced; The hem, Prettier: 100 columns, single quotes, semicolons, trailing: all, draft; The chalk line, Baseline: --generate-baseline, yours.
